scientific_goal: Bounded continuation of the rank19 core-innovation TCN: NLL control versus joint endpoint energy scores.
scientific_constraints: All arms start from the same frozen epoch-five best.pt snapshot; never chain arms.
Keep rank19, frozen imported operators, core_innovation TCN63, constant diagonal diffusion, native sampling and no trim.
Validation reps13/14 only; no test evaluation.
Same learning rate1e-4, two additional epochs, seed0, batch256; compare objectives only.
Use four particles, horizons2/5/10, example fraction0.02, joint position-displacement/velocity scoring and drift+diffusion gradients.
No energy/moment penalties in this first comparison. Energy score is not physical wave energy.
Training cap900seconds each; failed or timed-out trials are not resumed.
Screen parent and all arms at5000steps using identical seed and starts. Confirm each passing arm and parent at90000steps with same seed, reference and Welch8192.
Keep PSD peak contrast separate from band power and physical energy. Short-horizon score does not directly enforce peaks.
Three declared trials only; driver performs fixed confirmations then stops.
advisor_guidance: Fixed bounded grid; no additional training or architecture changes.
